test_title: PYST 30: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 10 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
In the following triads, each group of letters is related to the subsequent one following a certain logic. Select from the given options, the one that follows the same logic.

RAGE - ARGE - EARG

QUIZ - UQIZ - ZUQI
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

RAGE - ARGE - EARG

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2705b0e80ebdae36f4d7d135eae6e1c09322c4897aa17e24772206fccfcf8146.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fd70361df620e364f06eab20709eec522ee8eafb508a4b620f7bda1ee655b23e.png] 

And,

QUIZ - UQIZ - ZUQI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2950daa26e58297c8c126725a2cca5de060e422e0b6725344c700ac542a3fd33.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ddbfbe713b3404b807d978d9249fb69e21f6152b0ec8bbc123f29c3eb2045d09.png] 

Similarly,

HERD - EHRD - DEHR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4331b71db797fef9cff175118bc40cc7ce0500df656921a0b5a90c13e6607259.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ed8cfe3e143cf8238aa7bee7b435cf60530b6787f19beb0e757471006dcd7f83.png] 

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
